verses.en: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth’s sake.
verses.pt: Não a nós, Senhor, não a nós, mas ao teu nome dá glória, por amor da tua benignidade e da tua verdade.
verses.en_web: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
verses.en_bbe: Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to your name let glory be given, because of your mercy and your unchanging faith.

verses.en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?
verses.pt: Por que perguntariam as nações: Onde está o seu Deus?
verses.en_web: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
verses.en_bbe: Why may the nations say, Where is now their God?

verses.en: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
verses.pt: Mas o nosso Deus está nos céus; ele faz tudo o que lhe apraz.
verses.en_web: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
verses.en_bbe: But our God is in heaven: he has done whatever was pleasing to him.

verses.en: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.pt: Os ídolos deles são prata e ouro, obra das mãos do homem.
verses.en_web: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.en_bbe: Their images are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

verses.en: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
verses.pt: Têm boca, mas não falam; têm olhos, mas não vêem;
verses.en_web: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.
verses.en_bbe: They have mouths, but no voice; they have eyes, but they see not;

verses.en: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
verses.pt: têm ouvidos, mas não ouvem; têm nariz, mas não cheiram;
verses.en_web: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
verses.en_bbe: They have ears, but no hearing; they have noses, but no sense of smell;

verses.en: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
verses.pt: têm mãos, mas não apalpam; têm pés, mas não andam; nem som algum sai da sua garganta.
verses.en_web: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
verses.en_bbe: They have hands without feeling, and feet without power of walking; and no sound comes from their throat.

verses.en: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
verses.pt: Semelhantes a eles sejam os que fazem, e todos os que neles confiam.
verses.en_web: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
verses.en_bbe: Those who make them are like them; and so is everyone who puts his faith in them.

verses.en: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
verses.pt: Confia, ó Israel, no Senhor; ele é seu auxílio e seu escudo.
verses.en_web: Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
verses.en_bbe: O Israel, have faith in the Lord: he is their help and their breastplate.

verses.en: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
verses.pt: Casa de Arão, confia no Senhor; ele é seu auxílio e seu escudo.
verses.en_web: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
verses.en_bbe: O house of Aaron, have faith in the Lord: he is their help and their breastplate.

verses.en: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
verses.pt: Vós, os que temeis ao Senhor, confiai no Senhor; ele é seu auxílio e seu escudo.
verses.en_web: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
verses.en_bbe: You worshippers of the Lord, have faith in the Lord: he is their help and their breastplate.

verses.en: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.pt: O Senhor tem-se lembrado de nós, abençoar-nos-á; abençoará a casa de Israel; abençoará a casa de Arão;
verses.en_web: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has kept us in mind and will give us his blessing; he will send blessings on the house of Israel and on the house of Aaron.

verses.en: He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.
verses.pt: abençoará os que temem ao Senhor, tanto pequenos como grandes.
verses.en_web: He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.
verses.en_bbe: He will send blessings on the worshippers of the Lord, on the small and on the great.

verses.en: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
verses.pt: Aumente-vos o Senhor cada vez mais, a vós e a vossos filhos.
verses.en_web: May Yahweh increase you more and more, you and your children.
verses.en_bbe: May the Lord give you and your children still greater increase.

verses.en: Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.
verses.pt: Sede vós benditos do Senhor, que fez os céus e a terra.
verses.en_web: Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
verses.en_bbe: May you have the blessing of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

verses.en: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD’S: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
verses.pt: Os céus são os céus do Senhor, mas a terra, deu-a ele aos filhos dos homens.
verses.en_web: The heavens are the heavens of Yahweh; but the earth has he given to the children of men.
verses.en_bbe: The heavens are the Lord's; but the earth he has given to the children of men.

verses.en: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.
verses.pt: Os mortos não louvam ao Senhor, nem os que descem ao silêncio;
verses.en_web: The dead don’t praise Yah, neither any who go down into silence;
verses.en_bbe: The dead do not give praise to the Lord; or those who go down to the underworld.

verses.en: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.
verses.pt: nós, porém, bendiremos ao Senhor, desde agora e para sempre. Louvai ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: But we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!
verses.en_bbe: But we will give praise to the Lord now and for ever. Praise be to the Lord.
